content.user_title: Manage Lark Sheets with Reliable CLI Workflows
content.value_statement: Complex spreadsheet work requires precise commands and careful validation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through reliable Lark Sheets operations.
actual_capabilities: Create, import, export, inspect, and reorganize Lark workbooks and sheets.
Read and write cell values, formulas, styles, comments, images, and typed table data.
Insert, delete, resize, hide, freeze, merge, move, copy, fill, clear, and sort ranges.
Create and maintain charts, pivot tables, filters, filter views, conditional formats, and sparklines.
Translate Excel formulas into supported Lark Sheets formulas and verify returned results.
Combine related write operations into ordered batch updates with dry-run and confirmation guidance.
limitations: The skill requires an installed and authenticated lark-cli plus its declared lark-shared sibling guidance.
It does not search Lark Drive by file name; use lark-drive to locate unknown spreadsheets.
Write and delete operations can change shared data, so users must review targets and confirmations.
Some Excel formulas require translation because Lark Sheets does not support every Excel function or array behavior.

use_cases.title: Analyze operational data
use_cases.description: Inspect ranges, preserve data types, calculate summaries, and build charts or pivot tables for recurring reports.

use_cases.title: Maintain shared trackers
use_cases.description: Add rows, update formulas, apply consistent formatting, and verify changes without replacing unrelated content.

use_cases.title: Build financial models
use_cases.description: Create typed workbooks, translate formulas, add sensitivity views, and validate calculated outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this Lark Sheets URL: {{url}}. List its sheets, identify {{sheet}}, and summarize the structure without changing data.

prompt_templates.title: Update a data range
prompt_templates.prompt: Read {{sheet}} range {{range}}, apply {{changes}}, preserve nearby formatting and data types, then verify every changed cell.

prompt_templates.title: Create an analysis view
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze {{source_range}} by {{group_field}} and {{metric}}. Create a pivot table and suitable chart, then verify their source ranges.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate a financial model
prompt_templates.prompt: Rebuild {{model_name}} in Lark Sheets from {{source}}. Preserve typed inputs, translate formulas, add sensitivity analysis, and validate representative calculations.

output_examples.input: Inspect the sales workbook and summarize the available sheets.
output_examples.output: The workbook contains Sales, Targets, and Lookup sheets. Sales holds dated transactions, Targets contains monthly goals, and Lookup stores category mappings.

output_examples.input: Add a regional revenue summary and chart.
output_examples.output: Created a pivot table grouped by region with revenue totals. Added a column chart linked to the pivot results and verified the source range.

output_examples.input: Replace outdated labels in the active sheet.
output_examples.output: Previewed 18 matches in the requested range, replaced all confirmed labels, and verified that no old labels remained.

best_practices: Inspect workbook and sheet identifiers before reading or writing a range.
Use dry-run for destructive operations and verify affected ranges after every write.
Preserve numeric and date types when data must support sorting, formulas, charts, or pivots.
anti_patterns: Do not guess sheet names, identifiers, ranges, or target positions.
Do not overwrite source columns or shared data without checking the complete affected range.
Do not store numbers, percentages, or dates as formatted text when typed values are required.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires lark-cli, valid Lark authentication, and the declared lark-shared sibling guidance.

faq.question: Can it create a new spreadsheet?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a workbook and write untyped or typed data during creation.

faq.question: Can it work with existing Excel files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can import local Excel files and translate many Excel formulas for Lark Sheets.

faq.question: Does it support charts and pivot tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates native Lark charts and pivot tables that remain linked to sheet data.

faq.question: How does it reduce accidental data loss?
faq.answer: It recommends range inspection, dry-run previews, explicit confirmation, conservative placement, and post-write verification.

faq.question: Can it find a spreadsheet by name?
faq.answer: No. Use lark-drive search first, then provide the resulting spreadsheet URL or token.
